subject: Renewal uplift: proposal for staggered commit and GPU add-on
messages:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@cloudmetrics.com>
To: alex_martinez@redwood-inference.com
Cc: procure@cloudmetrics.com
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal planning / mid-term uplift questions

Hi Alex,

Hope you're well — our Dedicated environment with Redwood is up for renewal in November, and we have a short window to increase committed capacity ahead of that renewal. We're looking at adding +8 A100 GPUs to our existing pool to support a new inference workload expected in Q4. A few asks:

- Can you provide pricing and a few packaging options for a mid-term uplift (we'd prefer not to wait until the formal renewal)?
- How does Redwood prorate committed months if we add capacity part-way through a billing cycle/term?
- We need a throughput/latency guarantee (99th pctl latency for 2k token responses, and a baseline throughput target ~120 tokens/sec per GPU). Do you offer a credits schedule for missed SLOs?

Also, are there options to stagger the capacity addition (4 GPUs now, 4 in 90 days) with blended pricing? If you can share a short quote and the math, procurement can review quickly.

Attached: a utilization snapshot for August.

Thanks,
Olivia Chen
Sr. Platform Engineer
CloudMetrics


From: alex_martinez@redwood-inference.com
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@cloudmetrics.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood-inference.com, grace_oconnor@redwood-inference.com
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal planning / mid-term uplift questions

Hi Olivia — thanks for the context and the utilization file. Short answer: yes, we can support a mid-term uplift and a staggered commit. Below are three practical approaches with the prorate and SLA details:

Option A — Immediate uplift (8 GPUs), prorated remaining term
- List price: $8,500 / GPU / month
- Mid-term uplift discount (12-mo prorated commitment): 12% off list
- Proration: you pay the pro-rated monthly charge for the remainder of your current commitment period; then monthly billing moves to the new committed level. Example math in attached pricing-breakdown.xlsx.

Option B — Staggered add (4 now, 4 after 90 days), blended discount
- Month 0-3: 4 GPUs at 14% discount, Month 4+ (all 8): 16% discount (blended bill applied once second tranche comes online)
- Benefit: lower near-term cash flow, preserves ability to test workload before full scale

Option C — Full renewal uplift (upgrade at renewal to a larger commit)
- 24-month term, 20% discount on the larger commit, includes optional throughput SLA add-on

SLA / credits:
- 99th pctl latency SLO available as an add-on. If we miss the SLO for a given month more than 3 incidents, we credit 5% of that month's dedicated charge per missed incident (caps at 30%).
- Throughput guarantees are modeled per workload; we'll run a short validation test to certify 120 tok/s per GPU for your specific model and sequence lengths before finalizing the SLA.

Next steps: I attached a one-page pricing-breakdown and a draft SOW (CloudMetrics_SOW_v3.pdf). If Option B looks best, let me know and I'll loop in Rishi to approve pricing concessions for the staggered discount and produce an updated quote/DocuSign link.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive — Dedicated
Redwood Inference

From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@cloudmetrics.com>
To: alex_martinez@redwood-inference.com
Cc: CloudMetrics Procurement <procure@cloudmetrics.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal planning / mid-term uplift questions

Thanks Alex — this is helpful. Two follow-ups from procurement:

1) Proration detail: when you say "pro-rated remaining term", do we pay 100% of the remaining months at the uplifted rate, or do you calculate on-days remaining in the current month + full months thereafter? Our CFO wants the exact formula so they can model cash impact.

2) SLA credits: can you share an example calculation and whether credits apply to the uplift portion only or the entire dedicated bill? Also, how long after we sign would the throughput validation test be scheduled?

We prefer Option B (staggered) but need the concrete prorate formula and confirmation on whether the final blended discount is applied retroactively from the first tranche or only from when the second tranche is active.

Attached: utilization-report-aug.xlsx (full cluster metrics).

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
Olivia

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood-inference.com
To: alex_martinez@redwood-inference.com
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood-inference.com
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Renewal planning / mid-term uplift questions

Alex — forwarding Olivia's questions. Recommendation: offer Option B with a firm blended discount at close (16% overall) provided CloudMetrics commits to the second tranche within 90 days of the first activation. Concessions: we can go to 18% if they sign a short amendment (6-mo guarantee on the second tranche) and accept a non-refundable partial commitment deposit equal to 25% of the first month of the added capacity.

Suggested proposal text for the quote:
- Staggered add: 4 GPUs active Day 1, +4 GPUs active on Day 91.
- Billing/proration: day-based proration for the first partial month (charge = list_price * GPU_count * (days_active / days_in_billing_month) * (1 - discount)). From the second month onward, invoice full months at the agreed committed level.
- Blended discount applied retroactively to the first tranche once the second tranche is activated.
- SLA credits apply to total dedicated bill (base + uplift) prorated by the percent of capacity affected where relevant.

If Alex confirms, I'll approve up to 18% and generate an updated quote + DocuSign link.

-Rishi
Head of Sales — Redwood Inference

From: alex_martinez@redwood-inference.com
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@cloudmetrics.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood-inference.com, procure@cloudmetrics.com
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Final quote: Staggered commit (4 now, 4 in 90 days) — RM-2026-0421

Olivia — thanks for the patience. Per internal approval, attached is the updated quote and SOW. Key points summarized below: 

1) Pricing (Option B, accepted):
- List price: $8,500 / GPU / month
- Agreed blended discount: 16% (applies retroactively to tranche 1 once tranche 2 is activated within 90 days)
- Invoice schedule: day-based proration for the first partial month. Example: if tranche 1 activates on Sep 15 and Sep has 30 days, Sep charge for tranche 1 = $8,500 * 4 * (16/30) * (1 - 0.16).

2) Deposit & commitment terms:
- Non-refundable deposit (optional): 25% of first month of added capacity; required only if CloudMetrics requests a firm 18% concession. Otherwise 16% is approved without deposit.

3) SLA & credits:
- Throughput/latency validation will be scheduled within 7 business days of tranche activation.
- SLA credits apply to the total dedicated invoice and are prorated by percent of impacted capacity. Credits: 5% per qualified missed incident, cap 30% (same as earlier).

4) Next steps:
- If you confirm Option B with 16% blended discount, I'll send the DocuSign quote (linked) and schedule the validation test. If you want the 18% option, confirm and we'll include the 25% partial deposit line in the DocuSign.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/agree/abcdef123456
Shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_shared_quoter

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min call if you want to walk through the proration math.

Best,
Alex Martinez
